content: Yuda nanohon amna dugoho mata youpdec ohogung

Oro sep youp toctoc 5 ihoroc bödeuna öret socsoc böchon amna dugo mano Ananaias yu Yuda nanohon amna dugo au orin Röm nanohon nongoru mata kombic kombic amna au mano Tertulus, yu ambarac yangada Sisaria fohogoc. Yangat fonguna yu gavmanthon moröma Feliks yuot ongmuya Polhon matahon foro inogung.

Ihoroc inuya Feliksho Pol inong yuna ehuna Tertulusho forosingga Polha mata firing tanto ingoroc yogoc, “Amna moröma Feliks, gocho non Yuda nano ogepma sinom ning torengitarocmaha tongga non ogepgon itmanaina emoc au maöngkuboc. O goc gavman youp ogepma sinom tongmina mepmo noni dongyi bödegung.

Non ambaracho gochon toroc kiap ogepma angmanaina irot ogep moröma sinom kombiamon. Yuda nano böcsa danong non kombiamon, goc amna moröma sinom itaroc. Worocha non gang gendingmanaina ecec sinom ganamon.
Oro nonu ‘gochon bongono tongsamborec toninyit’ yongo mata ubarago mayonin. Muno nonu mata docutnogon yonaya gocu woroc kombing nimpi.

“Nontho amna ngo anaya yu tong bumbum koböc tongitac. Yu wömai amna torop au mano ‘Nasaretma’ yuhon dugo itac. Tongo yu sa woce woce itongmuna Yuda nano irot sakang imuna yu koreng tongmuya emoc tongidang.
Oro öngahemgonu yu öret socsoc bucin öngmuna wo Kopotorocho yangamin tong betbet toctocha togoc. Ihoroc tuna nontho yu karup sogit akep togomon.
Wohai gakabut amna wo iniya yuna tuctugo kombiantaroc, nonthon mata noni woi boinnogon.”
Tertulus yu ihoroc yongbödeuna Yuda amna yuot ebungma yu matano tong koing tongga yogung, “Mata ngoi boinno.”
Pol yu gavman Feliks inong tangtang togoc

Ihoroc yuya gavman amna Feliks yu oburoho Pol toroc au tong-imuna Pol yu mata ingoroc yogoc, “Nocho kombihat, gocu biruc koböc Yuda nanohon mata yangsoworengitarocmaha nonthon foro kombingbödeharoc. Worocha noc borongdetmaina mata ökene ingoroc iban kampiwa.

Sep youp toctoc 12 ihoroc idina noc Kopoto-roc yong kumeng imoc imocha Yerusalem öret socsoc bucin ögot. Nocho woce edeya owi amna koböcmaho nagung. Worocha goc ogep yu inong ac tia yu ganup, nocho mata boinno yatha woha muno.

Oro amna wo nocha mata metec yingma yu wömai kombingbödeang, nocho öret socsoc bucin yong osut mata au mayogot. O ihorocgon nocho Yuda nanohon fatmata yocyoc bucinthu o sa auhonthu ‘emoc tarut’ yongo suraro irotno masakang imongidot muno sinom.
Nocho yapmu wömuno matogot mahong yu önga nocha mata komanang sinom firing narang. Yui forono muno yang.

“Oro mata tungugon wömai yu boinno ying, nocu Yesuhon uyap tanmaina ombusakung nonihon Kopotoroc yu yong moröng imongitat. Uyap ngorocha wömai yu ‘Uyap wontucmuno’ ihoroc yongidang. Nocho kombiaya gendic nongoru mata irim toctocyi idangma worocho ambarac boinno idang. O ihorocgon Kopotorochon yong tuctuc amnaho mata yogungma wo ambarac nocho kombing tobihat.
Amna ngo nocha mata metec yingma yu ingoroc kombing tobingidang: Kopotorocho amna nongnongohu o amna wömunohu yu ambarac omocdecma doun wekonahing. Oro nocu wömai kiapmo worocgon kombing tobingitat.
Worocha tongga nocu bongono muno Kopotorocho yangamin orin owi amnaho yangamin eran itongmaina tong bumbum matongitat.

“Nocho sa ubarago sinom Yerusalem korungon itongedeya biruc koböc bödegoc. Korungon itongmaina öngahemgon nocho ibara fauna wönggon Yerusalem engmaina manomano owi amna uroci tongfat yecyechon fengga nakain suraro imogot. O ihorocgon nocho ‘öret socsoc bucin öret socsoc youp towa’ yongo ebot.

Tongo nocho tong bumbumna muno Kopotorocho yangamin sacsago itmaina öret socsoc youp tongga edeya Yuda amna au Esia gurocinma yu engmuya nagung. Yuho nagungan bongono wocin wömai owi amna koböcmaho nocot maidung. O nocho owi amna irot sakac sakac mata au mainogot.
Nocho tong bumbum au matogot mahong togotanu wömai amna Esiama yu gocho yangamin ngocin itmuya nocha mata firing nerup.
Wohong yu ngocin maeng. Worocha amna ngocin idangma yu muyu nocho yaö tong bumbum togotma worochon foro tuctugo nanuya kombina.

Nocho mata tungu yogotma worochong yu oröc matong imochu. Nocho yuhon mata youpdec itmaina ingoroc mambodot: ‘Noc boinno sinom kombing tobihat, owi amna ambaracho omocdecma wekongga idongonahing. Mata worocha son noc mata youpdec tohong nugung.’”

Polho mata ihoroc yongbödeuna gavman amna Feliks yuho yogoc, “Mata youp ngocin bödehun. Namba wan ofisa Lisias yu ehangocan bongono wocin wömai nonu mata ngo sakana fiuna nocho ya böde-angoc.” Feliks yu wömai kombing tobic tobic surarohon foro urop kombingbödegoc.

Tongo yu tawa amnahon ofisa ingoroc inogoc, “Pol sogito yi bucin tohong yuarut mahong sendec akep toninga. Muno son muyu nip orugi yu yang banauya yu ogep yi bucin engmuya Pol manomanoha tongfat yengitnung.”
Pol yu biruc yai ihoroc yi bucin idoc

Oro sep youp toctoc auho bödeuna Feliks orin oweno mano Drusila yu yi bucin ebomoroc. Feliks oweno yu Yuda owi au. Yu ehunya tawa amnaho Pol sogito yuot teboc. Teuna Polho Feliks orin oweno Yesu Duic kombing tobing imoc imochon foro inong tuctuc tuna kombigomoroc.

Kombiunya Polho Kopotorocho yangamin nong-nongo idithon mata orin ‘amnaho inoin idit itonggong angitgon angtorengitnung’ yongo worochon foro fandat inogoc. Tongo mit yu yogoc, Kopotorocho owi amna ambarac mata youpdec fohong yuangoc. Polho ihoroc fandat inuna Feliks woroc kombingga botongga yogoc, “Urop, imi fahun. Oipmonu nocot bego au idinai wömai nocho mata siaya wönggon ehiruc.”
Feliks yu komong ducha Pol ihoroc inogoc mahong irotnon wömai yu ‘Polho möneng nampun’ yongo kombigoc. Worocha yu bongono bongono Pol inong yuna mata mata yongidomoroc.

Ihoroc tongga idinya biruc yai ihoroc bödegoc. Tuna mit gavmanthon au mano Porsius Festus yuho Feliks mongurac togoc. Ihoroc tongo Feliks yu ‘Yuda nanoho nocha irot ogep kombiarut’ yongo Pol ma asan imogoc. Tuna Polho yi bucingon idoc.
